title: Soil and Litter GitHub Issues Tracker
text:
This week, I streamlined the model validation pipeline by transitioning to a per-dataset schema (#519), refactoring dataset screening processes (#514, #522), screening soil and litter datasets (#526), and implementing a Shiny dashboard (#520). For model parameterisation and input data tools, I parsed the VE codebase to build a constant database (#508) and updated the subset_nc() function (#510, addressing #509). My near-term focus is on recompiling soil input data (#538, addressing #489) and preparing the newly screened soil datasets for integration with VE model outputs (#62).
